talks.text: If your country got attacked tomorrow... who would actually come to help? Real treaties only. 197 countries, one by one.
Teal: a treaty with the United States.
Green: a bigger neighbor protects them.
And grey... completely alone. Let's go!
NATO. An attack on one is an attack on all.
Mexico: alone! It left the Rio Treaty in 2002.
United Kingdom: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Ireland: the EU defense clause! Neutral... but in the EU.
Portugal: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Luxembourg: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Denmark: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Finland: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
NATO. And soon, the strongest army in Europe.
Czech Republic: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Slovenia: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Albania: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Bulgaria: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Ukraine: alone! Not in NATO... yet.
Latvia: NATO. Thirty-one allies would come!
Russia: Belarus, its Central Asian allies... and North Korea!
Colombia: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Peru: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Chile: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Argentina: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Uruguay: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Paraguay: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Brazil: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Panama: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Costa Rica: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Honduras: the Rio Treaty, with America.
El Salvador: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Guatemala: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Haiti: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Dominican Republic: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Bahamas: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Trinidad and Tobago: the Rio Treaty, with America.
Saint Kitts and Nevis: no one!
Armenia: alone! It froze its Russian alliance.
We were in Russia's alliance... we froze it.
Iran: no one! Close to Russia... but no treaty.
Israel: no treaty... but very good friends in Washington.
No treaty. Just very good friends in Washington.
United Arab Emirates: the Arab League!
No alliances. We never needed them.
South Korea: a treaty with America.
The United States. By treaty, since 1960.
Officially? Nobody. Unofficially... we will see.
Would anyone defend your country? Comment below!
